Practice
While practising, press J in a fight to jump between phases, boss HP points and attacks.   
Practice runs skip the opening wait and are not recorded.


How to Play
A / D move · Space or W jump, hold to fly · Shift dash (invulnerable, damages the worm) · S drop through platforms; in the air, hold S + Space together to hover (flight drains 50% faster) · E grapple · B scaffold · P pause
1-4 or mouse wheel swaps weapon class (Melee, Ranged, Magic, Summoner; pick variants under Loadout)
Left click attacks · Hellkite: hold to charge · Summons vanish when you put the Summoner weapon away
Q healing potion (250 life, 20s cooldown) · M music · N sound effects · T timer
Read the telegraphs, dash through the gaps, and keep your wings charged.
